speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I hear you mentioning fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; these are concerning signs that require a systematic evaluation. To begin, have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits, stool color, or appetite accompanying your abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those symptoms; the combination of weight loss and night sweats is significant. Given the enlarged supraclavicular lymph node and abdominal pain, have you noticed any lumps or swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.
